case_title: Vadlakonda Lenin v. State of Andhra Pradesh
aggravating_circumstances: Demanding dowry, harassment, and ill-treatment of the deceased
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, a man, and the victim, a woman, were married. The accused had been persistently demanding additional dowry from the victim and was harassing and ill-treating her. The accused and the victim, along with two witnesses, attended a betrothal function for the brother of the victim the evening before the incident. After the function, there was a quarrel between the accused and the victim. The next morning, the victim was found lying injured in her own house by two witnesses. The accused was seen fleeing from the house by one of the witnesses. The accused was not found until nearly 15 days later, when he was arrested. After his arrest, a knife and a blood-stained shirt were recovered. The accused explained his absence by stating he learned of the incident from the newspaper and then informed his sister, which was considered unnatural and inconsistent with normal human behavior.
